test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent Memory change-default, training and target restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove an approved Memory Configuration change persists and restore the explicitly selected factory or project target while every DIMM trains with required capacity, speed, ECC/RAS and topology.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
DEFAULT_TARGET plus separate factory/project memory matrices
Backup, recipe application and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline page, DIMM inventory and RAS evidence; change one approved reversible control/group, save and wait full training deadline, prove retention/effective state. Invoke firmware Load Defaults and record factory state. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, apply approved recipe and retrain. Compare final page and every DIMM/effective metric to selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The change persists; all phases meet signed training, slot/capacity/speed/ECC/NUMA/RAS and boot criteria; factory output is separate; final state exactly matches selected Factory Default or Project Recipe.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against declared DEFAULT_TARGET with row-specific screens and per-DIMM evidence. Factory cannot satisfy Project Recipe. Missing DIMM, fallback, topology/RAS anomaly, wrong restoration or training/boot failure is FAIL. Missing target/oracle/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, matrices, DIMM population, value effects, training limit and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or incompatible memory controls.
Back up project settings; preserve training/SEL/EDAC/MCA/kernel evidence and do not interrupt training early.
Operator controls save/training/default/recipe/recovery; no automatic cycle/retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24 approval and platform/per-DIMM identity
Declared target, factory/project matrices and reversible change/training rationale
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, optional recipe and final screenshots with training timing
Per-phase DIMM slot/channel/rank, capacity, speed, ECC/RAS and NUMA/interleave
Backup/restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on training loop, DIMM loss, fallback, RAS or boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Wait the approved deadline, then qualified personnel restore backed-up project state via signed recovery; do not reuse row 2179 evidence or blindly cycle/retry.
